{{Quote|It was protection, yes, but not for me. It was to protect Admiral Ar'alani, the officer commanding the transport that arrived an hour ago to take the freed Geroon slaves back to their world.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
A '''transport ship''' was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]]. After the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were defeated and the [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were [[Battle for Outbound Flight|freed]] by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] species and their [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|government]], the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] arrived to take the Geroons to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Geroon]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
